selection_rationale: Specialty microphones chosen to teach powering and connector differences rather than tone: RF condenser and battery/phantom shotguns for film/ENG (MKH 416, CMIT 5, NTG2, NTG5), lavalier/headset/electret capsules on P48, transmitter bias or plug-in power with TA4/LEMO/3.5 mm plugs (Sanken COS-11D, COS-11D HWM, RØDE Lavalier II), XLR5 stereo and binaural systems including the French ORTF reference (SCHOEPS MSTC 74, MKH 418-S, RØDE NT4, Neumann USM 69 i and KU 100), a boundary capsule with separate amplifier, measurement mics, a condenser contact pickup and a USB-C mic. Candidates on sites that could not be read (DPA, Shure, Audio-Technica, Behringer, Crown, Schertler, Sennheiser AMBEO / MKE 2) were swapped for equivalent, fully sourced models after the shared search budget ran out.
